caption: The video captures a close-up, eye-level view of a stemmed wine glass filled with clear water on a light wooden table. A metal fork is inside the glass, and refraction below the waterline magnifies its bowl into a broad dark oval while its tines appear as three bright vertical bars. Above the surface, the slender fork handle and a second utensil handle remain visible near the rim. A person's fingers rest on the upper-right rim of the glass, holding position with only slight movement. In the soft background, a smaller footed glass mug of water sits beside a thin water spill on the table. Throughout, the refracted fork, waterline, hand, mug, and spill stay largely in place, drifting only subtly as the handheld view shifts.
